answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that vests only after a season of verified useful work. A Sybil farmer spawning thousands of clones must fund every one, so the attack's cost scales linearly while honest agents earn the stake back. Like a meadow that only feeds grazers who tend it, or timber cut only above the ridge line after years of growth, the system rewards patient, verifiable contribution and prices cheap identity churn out of existence.
